signals.text: Chelsea miss Joao Pedro... and can't stop conceding goals. Chelsea's problem was defending, but with Joao Pedro ruled out through injury, scoring goals has also become an issue.

Liverpool watch £51.5m-rated Smit - Saturday's gossip. Netherlands midfielder Kees Smit is watched by Liverpool, Tottenham lead the race for Brazil defender Arthur Dias and Monaco's Folarin Balogun is expected to leave in January.

Goodwin double helps London City win at struggling Charlton. London City Lionesses earn their first away win of the season, with Isobel Goodwin scoring twice, as they emphatically beat a struggling Charlton side who have now lost all three of their WSL games.
